mechanism_narrative: Rising consumer demand measured by HOUST coincides with stronger S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero (t-test p > 0.05) when HOUST growth exceeds +5% in the preceding month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in employment growth (PAYEMS) above 50,000 jobs in a month is associated with positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns as labor market strength signals economic resilience.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative or flat when trigger is met (t-test p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 50th percentile over the past 3 months suggests supply-side constraints, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive despite sustained INDPRO weakness (t-test p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the 3-month moving average of FEDFUNDS falls by more than 0.25 percentage points, the S&P 500 exhibits positive 20-day forward returns as investors anticipate rate-cutting expectations.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically positive when trigger occurs (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent strength in both consumer (HOUST) and business (RSAFS) demand series produces a significant positive 5-day S&P 500 forward return as dual momentum confirms market optimism.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significant after controlling for either HOUST or RSAFS individually (F-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment below 4.5% for two consecutive months is associated with negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns as market anticipates softening labor demand.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when trigger is met (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a regime of falling consumer prices (CPIAUCSL) and rising S&P 500 futures, positive 60-day forward returns are more likely when FEDFUNDS remains unchanged for three consecutive meetings.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL < 305 and FEDFUNDS unchanged for 3 months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are flat or negative despite the trigger (t-test p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) followed within one month by a decline in consumer confidence (HOUST) predicts negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns as a supply-demand imbalance emerges.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 95th percentile and HOUST < 50th percentile in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive when the interaction trigger occurs (t-test p < 0.05).
